page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.26xlarge is a large-scale general-purpose virtual machine instance within the ecs.g6 instance family. Powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this instance provides 104 dedicated vCPUs alongside 384.0 GB of system memory. Hosted on a KVM hypervisor, the hardware configuration delivers a balanced memory-to-vCPU allocation of approximately 3.69 GB per core, intended for enterprise software requiring high core counts.

The instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps to support high data throughput across distributed cloud infrastructure. It provides no bundled local NVMe storage, requiring reliance on external block storage volumes for persistent data retention. Additionally, the hardware profile includes no discrete GPU accelerators and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

By offering a high density of 104 vCPUs and 384 GB of memory in a single virtual machine without attached local storage overhead, the ecs.g6.26xlarge delivers predictable compute resources for parallelized enterprise operations. The balanced resource ratio matches the requirements of large web application clusters, enterprise resource planning deployments, build servers, and application backend infrastructure.
